test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) met

(B) his friend

(C) at the station

(D) Rohit
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **DABC**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject **"Rohit"**, which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following the subject, **"met"** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what Rohit did, indicated by **part (A).**
 
• **Next comes** "his friend," which provides more context to the sentence, indicated by **part (B).**
 
• **Finally,** "at the station" completes the sentence by specifying the location, indicated by **part (C).**

Therefore, the correct answer is **DABC.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (DCBA):** This option starts with "Rohit at the station his friend met," which creates an incorrect and awkward sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2 (DBAC):** This option starts with "Rohit his friend at the station met," which disrupts the logical sequence of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (DACB):** This option starts with "Rohit met at the station his friend," which places the location before the object, making the sentence unclear.
